resources.string: Enables control of apps via spoken commands. Translates voice commands directly to navigation gestures, clicks, scrolls, and text typing.

1. Grant Microphone and Screen Overlay permissions if requested.
2. Enable the service in Settings.
3. A blue floating microphone icon will appear.
4. Drag the mic anywhere. Tap it to start voice control.

• "Open YouTube" / "YouTube kholo"
• "Search YouTube for Android app builder"
• "Click Search"
• "Type Hello World"
• "Scroll Down" / "Scroll Up"
• "Go Back" / "Go Home"
